positive_sequences.name: failures_then_success_same_account
positive_sequences.scenario: Four failures followed by a success for the same account.
positive_sequences.rationale: Ordered sequence completes inside the correlation window for one group key.

positive_sequences.name: failures_then_success_admin_account
positive_sequences.scenario: Failures followed by a success for an administrative account.
positive_sequences.rationale: Ordered sequence completes inside the correlation window for one group key.

negative_sequences.name: success_then_failures
negative_sequences.scenario: A success followed by later failures for the same account.
negative_sequences.rationale: The ordered requirement is not satisfied because the success comes first.

negative_sequences.name: failures_and_success_different_accounts
negative_sequences.scenario: Failures for one account and a success for another.
negative_sequences.rationale: No single group key contains both stages of the sequence.

negative_sequences.name: success_outside_window
negative_sequences.scenario: Failures followed by a success after the correlation window has elapsed.
negative_sequences.rationale: The sequence exceeds the fifteen minute timespan.

notes: All sequences are synthetic and deterministic. Negative sequences break exactly one correlation requirement each: ordering, grouping, threshold, or timespan.
